brief:
The Board of Peace has warned that the Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse without immediate action, citing continued fighting and implementation delays, Al Jazeera English reported. The US-led board decried violations of the 2025 ceasefire agreement and called for urgent steps to prevent the accord from unraveling.

The warning comes as both parties continue military operations and fail to meet agreed terms. The board's statement signals mounting concern among mediators that the truce, brokered with American backing, may not hold without decisive intervention.
dek: The US-led board has decried continued fighting in Gaza and delays in implementing the terms of a 2025 ceasefire deal.
title: US-led peace board warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse
